$meta.name: Dahab Focal design tokens
$meta.statusNote: Filled from the Claude Design project on 2026-09-07, revision v3 (Design System.dc.html) / dahab-focal.tokens.json@3.0.0. The board superseded the pre-design brief in CLAUDE.md; the CLAUDE.md non-negotiables were rewritten to match this file in the same series of commits. Every ratio below is recomputed from the hexes here with scripts/contrast.mjs — the board's own annotations are not trusted. Two hexes were corrected in code and are NOT yet corrected in the canvas: clay-700 (#8A7B68 -> #7D6D5E, was 3.95:1 as muted text) and danger-text (#C13333 -> #B82D2D, was 4.26:1 on its own surface). See docs/FOUNDATION.md.

contrast.note: Recomputed from the hexes in this file, never taken from an annotation. Each minimum is set at or just below the computed ratio; the computed value is recorded in the note. A palette edit that drops one of these below its minimum fails the build.

required.note: primary text on the page — computes 11.19 (board annotates 11.4)
every mark and hairline — computes 8.93 (board annotates 9.0)
THE primary button: ink-900 on blush-200 — computes 8.20 (board annotates 9.4). There is no white-on-fill button in this system.
coral-700, the only coral for text on light — computes 5.14 (board annotates 5.2)
gold text on the rewards/AI surface — computes 5.37 (board annotates 5.4 in JSON, 5.7 in the CSS comment)
CORRECTED to #B82D2D — computes 4.68 (was #C13333 at 4.26, sub-AA). Error text must clear AA as text, independent of the icon and label beside it.
CORRECTED to #7D6D5E — computes 4.78 on cream-50 (was #8A7B68 at 3.95). Carries small, caption and overline, incl. the FX and legal disclosure.
Night Dive primary text — computes 14.32 (board annotates 12.6, which was measured against surface #0F2E2E before the page ground was darkened to #0A2422)

forbidden.reason: White on the blush-200 CTA fill is 1.42:1. The CTA label is ink-900 (cta-label). This is the old white-on-coral trap; it must stay impossible.
clay-500 is the brand accent for the word 'focal' only. It is 2.40:1 on the page and is never body text.
cream-400 is 2.14:1 on the page. It is decoration and empty-state dots only, never text.

cream-50.note: page background and cards. No pure white anywhere in this system.

blush-200.note: PRIMARY CTA fill, and THE offset shape for life

coral-700.note: the ONLY coral for text on light

clay-500.note: brand secondary — the word 'focal'. 2.40:1, never body text

clay-700.note: CORRECTED from #8A7B68 (3.95:1). Muted text — 4.78:1 on cream-50. Not yet corrected in the canvas.

dune-700.note: gold text on the sand/AI surface

ink-line.note: every line, every mark — 8.93:1. NEVER pure black.

ink-scrim.note: photo scrims; also the Night Dive card surface

danger-text.note: CORRECTED from #C13333 (4.26:1). 4.68:1 on danger-surface. Not yet corrected in the canvas.

info-text.note: 4.29:1 on info-surface — sub-AA, flagged in docs/FOUNDATION.md, not fixed

shape-water.note: the filled silhouette behind a water mark

shape-life.note: the filled silhouette behind a life/motion mark

shape-land.note: the filled silhouette behind a land/culture mark

focus-ring.note: = lagoon-focus. 2px ring at 2px offset, drawn as the camera-focus ring.

cta-label.note: = ink-900. The primary button label is always this.

border-strong.note: the board calls this the minimum control boundary; it is only 2.80:1 on bg — flagged sub-1.4.11 in docs/FOUNDATION.md, not fixed

line.note: the mark line inverts to cream at night

gradient.$note: Named washes from the board. Full stop lists and angles, verbatim.

seascape.note: the CSS stand-in for a sea photo: sky, horizon, water in one stack

seascape-desert.note: the CSS stand-in for a desert photo

photo-scrim.note: from the bottom edge wherever text overlays imagery

display.note: display, brand and every price. Round terminals that echo the line caps. Never below 19px, never a UI label. Variable 400..800.

ui.note: all UI and body — Latin, Cyrillic and Arabic in one family. Variable 300..600.

arabicDisplay.note: the rounded Arabic companion for display

mono.note: the system mono stack. The board uses ui-monospace for token names, focal-point read-outs and IDs. There is no bundled mono face.

weight.$note: Baloo 2 sets display at 600. Rubik carries UI: 300 / 400 / 500, and 500 is the heaviest UI weight.

displayXL.note: hero titles, max 2 lines. Tracking is positive.

caption.note: legal and FX disclosure, in text-muted

arabic.$note: Arabic gets +20% line-height (multiplier 1.2) and never sets below 15px.

wordmark.$note: DAHAB in display 600 at +0.01em (positive — it sits open). 'focal' at 0.22 of the DAHAB cap height, +0.2em tracking, in clay-500.

shadow.$note: Prefer a tinted surface over a shadow. Shadows exist for lift only, and are warm-tinted (ink-900 at low alpha), never neutral grey.

confetti.note: booking success, from the bottom edge, once

signature.$note: sheet rise overshoots 6px; card lift is 4px; loading is a jellyfish mark drifting up through a mint wash; pull-to-refresh is a wave that crests at 60px and breaks on release. Every signature collapses to a 120ms opacity fade under prefers-reduced-motion.

texture.$note: paper grain at 0.04 opacity, multiply blend, on cream surfaces, never over text. Caustic shimmer at 0.06 opacity on mint washes only, 14s drift.

a11y.$note: WCAG 2.2 AA is a build gate. Ratios recomputed from the hexes in this file.

locale.$note: en-GB source; ar-EG is the only RTL. Western digits by default (Egyptian norm); Eastern is a settings toggle. Design for +40% label width — nothing truncates. Expansion factors: de 1.35, es 1.25, ru 1.20, fr 1.20, it 1.15, ar 0.75.

icon.$note: 37 marks on a 100-unit grid, 3px ink-line over a filled pastel silhouette offset +4/+4, six strokes or fewer. Purely abstract marks (sea, wind, weave, reef, depth, coral-fan) carry no silhouette. spark and tick are the two UI glyphs. The illustration set is the same hand, larger.

noFlip.$note: CLAUDE.md rule: icons of physical objects and media transport controls carry noFlip; everything else mirrors in RTL. The explicit per-icon list is not published on the board — this is a first pass and needs design sign-off (see docs/FOUNDATION.md).
